result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the new order, so it isn't covered by one.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added the same `CASE t.priority …` ordering that the sales rep's open-ticket list uses to its `ORDER BY`, and updated the method's comment. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are filtered out as before.
